summary.name: mohu.ai
summary.one_liner: mohu.ai is a domain name listed for sale on Spaceship, where visitors can submit an offer to buy it.
use_cases: submit an offer for a domain
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sales listing for the domain mohu.ai, hosted through Spaceship. It asks visitors to enter a basic personal information form and an offer amount of up to 9 digits. After submitting, visitors are redirected to spaceship.com to negotiate the purchase. The page states that transaction support is free and that payments are secure. It does not describe any software, service or website content served at the domain itself.
notable: Offers are negotiated through Spaceship after the personal info form
Free transaction support and secure payments claimed on the page
Listing in hanishrao/collective-ai-tools associates the domain with MoHu AI, a screenwriter and web novel assistance service
caveats: No asking price is shown; the price is negotiated
The page itself describes only the domain sale, not a working product
The listing's MoHu AI description is not confirmed by this page
